```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
  library(readr)
})

grn_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "GRN_analysis")
figure_dir <- file.path(grn_dir, "GRN_visualization")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

plot_data_file <- file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6A_TF_recurrence_plot_data_updated.csv")

stopifnot(file.exists(plot_data_file))
```

# A. TF recurrence across subnetworks

Candidate transcription factors are shown across the 15 shoot subnetworks. A
colored tile indicates that a TF is present in a subnetwork, with tile color
representing outdegree (the number of target genes). Asterisks represent
adjusted-P-value significance (`*` $P_{adj}<0.05$; `**` $P_{adj}<0.01$; `***`
$P_{adj}<0.001$). TFs from the same family are placed in adjacent rows; within
each family, TFs are ordered by recurrence and total outdegree.

```{r prepare-figure6a-data}
required_columns <- c(
  "rank_within_module",
  "regulatoryGene",
  "subnetwork",
  "outdegree",
  "enrichment_p_adj",
  "tf_label",
  "tf_class",
  "subnetworks_present",
  "total_outdegree"
)

plot_data <- readr::read_csv(
  plot_data_file,
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "Windows-1252"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(plot_data))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Plot data file is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(regulatoryGene, subnetwork, tf_label, tf_class),
      ~ trimws(as.character(.x))
    ),
    outdegree = as.numeric(outdegree),
    enrichment_p_adj = as.numeric(enrichment_p_adj),
    subnetworks_present = as.numeric(subnetworks_present),
    total_outdegree = as.numeric(total_outdegree),
    padj_significance = case_when(
      enrichment_p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      enrichment_p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
      enrichment_p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(regulatoryGene),
    regulatoryGene != "",
    !is.na(subnetwork),
    subnetwork != "",
    !is.na(tf_label),
    tf_label != ""
  )

subnetwork_order <- c(
  "red",
  "green",
  "turquoise",
  "magenta",
  "cyan",
  "midnightblue",
  "lightcyan",
  "pink",
  "brown",
  "skyblue",
  "white",
  "royalblue",
  "lightyellow",
  "darkgreen",
  "black"
)

available_subnetworks <- unique(plot_data$subnetwork)

missing_subnetworks <- setdiff(subnetwork_order, available_subnetworks)
unexpected_subnetworks <- setdiff(available_subnetworks, subnetwork_order)

if (length(missing_subnetworks) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Requested subnetworks are missing from the ranking data: ",
    paste(missing_subnetworks, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(unexpected_subnetworks) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "Ranking data contain subnetworks omitted from the requested order: ",
    paste(unexpected_subnetworks, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

tf_order <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(regulatoryGene) %>%
  summarise(
    tf_label = dplyr::first(tf_label),
    tf_class = dplyr::first(tf_class),
    subnetworks_present = n_distinct(subnetwork),
    total_outdegree = sum(outdegree, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(tf_class = coalesce(na_if(tf_class, ""), "Unclassified")) %>%
  arrange(
    tf_class,
    desc(subnetworks_present),
    desc(total_outdegree),
    tf_label
  )

tf_levels <- rev(tf_order$tf_label)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    tf_label = factor(tf_label, levels = tf_levels),
    subnetwork = factor(subnetwork, levels = subnetwork_order)
  )

matrix_background <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  tf_label = factor(tf_levels, levels = tf_levels),
  subnetwork = factor(subnetwork_order, levels = subnetwork_order)
)
```

```{r figure6a, fig.width=11, fig.height=12}
matrix_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = matrix_background,
    aes(x = subnetwork, y = tf_label),
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(
      x = subnetwork,
      y = tf_label,
      fill = outdegree
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(
      x = subnetwork,
      y = tf_label,
      label = padj_significance,
      color = outdegree
    ),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = "Target genes\n(outdegree)",
    low = "#DCEFED",
    high = "#123B4A",
    trans = "sqrt",
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#1A1A1A",
    high = "white",
    trans = "sqrt",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Shoot subnetwork",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Adjusted P value:",
      "* < 0.05; ** < 0.01; *** < 0.001"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

figure6a <- matrix_plot

figure6a

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6A_TF_recurrence.png"),
  figure6a,
  width = 11,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6A_TF_recurrence.pdf"),
  figure6a,
  width = 11,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)
```

# B. Simplified consensus 3% network

The complete consensus 3% network contains 12,191 genes and 101,721 edges in
one connected component. It therefore does not separate into disconnected
networks. The overview below displays it as one network while limiting the
display to the strongest representative edges from the most connected TFs.
WGCNA module membership is used only to sample genes across the full network;
it is not shown in the layout. Gene labels and a force-directed layout are
deliberately omitted to keep rendering inexpensive.

```{r prepare-figure6b-network}
consensus_network_file <- file.path(grn_dir, "consensus_network",
  "consensus_network_deg_tf_top3pct_edges.csv"
)
module_membership_file <- file.path(grn_dir, "selected_module_genes.csv"
)
tf_summary_file <- file.path(grn_dir, "subnetwork",
  "combined_tf_ranking_outdegree_first",
  "TF_summary_across_all_modules.csv"
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(consensus_network_file),
  file.exists(module_membership_file),
  file.exists(tf_summary_file)
)

# These limits bound the plotted network at approximately
# 16 modules x 10 TFs x 15 targets = 2,400 edges.
top_tfs_per_module <- 10L
top_targets_per_tf_module <- 15L
network_seed <- 617L

module_membership <- readr::read_csv(
  module_membership_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    gene = as.character(gene_id),
    module = as.character(module)
  ) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

consensus_edges <- readr::read_csv(
  consensus_network_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    from = as.character(regulatoryGene),
    to = as.character(targetGene),
    GeoMeanRank = as.numeric(GeoMeanRank)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    module_membership %>%
      rename(to = gene, target_module = module),
    by = "to"
  ) %>%
  mutate(target_module = coalesce(target_module, "unassigned"))

module_levels <- c(subnetwork_order, "unassigned")

tf_annotations <- readr::read_csv(
  tf_summary_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    from = as.character(regulatoryGene),
    tf_acronym = na_if(trimws(as.character(tf_acronym)), "")
  ) %>%
  distinct(from, .keep_all = TRUE)

top5_tfs <- consensus_edges %>%
  count(from, name = "full_outdegree") %>%
  slice_max(full_outdegree, n = 5L, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(full_outdegree), from) %>%
  mutate(outdegree_rank = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(tf_annotations, by = "from") %>%
  mutate(
    tf_display_name = coalesce(
      tf_acronym,
      sub("^MtrunA17_", "", from)
    ),
    top5_label = paste0(
      "#", outdegree_rank, " ", tf_display_name,
      "\nOutdegree = ", scales::comma(full_outdegree)
    )
  )

top_module_tfs <- consensus_edges %>%
  count(target_module, from, name = "module_outdegree") %>%
  group_by(target_module) %>%
  slice_max(
    module_outdegree,
    n = top_tfs_per_module,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

network_plot_edges <- consensus_edges %>%
  inner_join(
    top_module_tfs,
    by = c("target_module", "from")
  ) %>%
  group_by(target_module, from) %>%
  slice_min(
    GeoMeanRank,
    n = top_targets_per_tf_module,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Explicitly retain representative edges for every global top-five TF, even if
# one is not among the top ten TFs for a particular target module.
top5_plot_edges <- consensus_edges %>%
  semi_join(top5_tfs, by = "from") %>%
  group_by(from) %>%
  slice_min(
    GeoMeanRank,
    n = top_targets_per_tf_module,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

network_plot_edges <- bind_rows(
  network_plot_edges,
  top5_plot_edges
) %>%
  distinct(from, to, .keep_all = TRUE)

network_plot_nodes <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = unique(c(network_plot_edges$from, network_plot_edges$to))
) %>%
  left_join(module_membership, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(
    top5_tfs %>%
      select(
        gene = from,
        full_outdegree,
        outdegree_rank,
        top5_label
      ),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    module = coalesce(module, "unassigned"),
    module = factor(module, levels = module_levels),
    node_type = if_else(
      gene %in% network_plot_edges$from,
      "TF",
      "Target"
    )
  )

# Use a deterministic hub-centered radial layout. The highest-outdegree TF is
# at the origin, the next four TFs form the innermost ring, the remaining TFs
# occupy a second ring, and target genes fill the outer annulus.
set.seed(network_seed)

golden_angle <- pi * (3 - sqrt(5))

plot_node_degree <- bind_rows(
  network_plot_edges %>% count(gene = from, name = "degree"),
  network_plot_edges %>% count(gene = to, name = "degree")
) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(plot_degree = sum(degree), .groups = "drop")

network_plot_nodes <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  left_join(plot_node_degree, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(plot_degree = coalesce(plot_degree, 0L))

top5_layout <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  filter(!is.na(outdegree_rank)) %>%
  arrange(outdegree_rank) %>%
  mutate(
    radius = if_else(outdegree_rank == 1L, 0, 0.9),
    angle = if_else(
      outdegree_rank == 1L,
      0,
      (outdegree_rank - 2L) * 2 * pi / 4 + pi / 4
    ),
    x = radius * cos(angle),
    y = radius * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)

other_tf_layout <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  filter(node_type == "TF", is.na(outdegree_rank)) %>%
  arrange(desc(plot_degree), gene) %>%
  mutate(
    radial_index = row_number(),
    radial_count = n(),
    radius = 2.0 + 1.15 * sqrt((radial_index - 0.5) / radial_count),
    angle = radial_index * golden_angle,
    x = radius * cos(angle),
    y = radius * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)

target_layout <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  filter(node_type == "Target") %>%
  arrange(desc(plot_degree), gene) %>%
  mutate(
    radial_index = row_number(),
    radial_count = n(),
    radius = 4.0 + 4.8 * sqrt((radial_index - 0.5) / radial_count),
    angle = radial_index * golden_angle,
    x = radius * cos(angle),
    y = radius * sin(angle)
  ) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)

network_layout <- bind_rows(
  top5_layout,
  other_tf_layout,
  target_layout
)

network_plot_nodes <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  left_join(network_layout, by = "gene")

if (anyNA(network_plot_nodes$x) || anyNA(network_plot_nodes$y)) {
  stop("Hub-centered radial layout failed to position every plotted gene.")
}

top5_plot_nodes <- network_plot_nodes %>%
  filter(!is.na(outdegree_rank))

network_plot_edges <- network_plot_edges %>%
  left_join(
    network_plot_nodes %>%
      select(gene, from_x = x, from_y = y),
    by = c("from" = "gene")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    network_plot_nodes %>%
      select(gene, to_x = x, to_y = y),
    by = c("to" = "gene")
  )

readr::write_csv(
  network_plot_edges,
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6B_simplified_network_edges.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  network_plot_nodes,
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6B_simplified_network_nodes.csv")
)
```

```{r figure6b, fig.width=13, fig.height=13}
figure6b <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = network_plot_edges,
    aes(
      x = from_x,
      y = from_y,
      xend = to_x,
      yend = to_y
    ),
    color = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.08,
    alpha = 0.055
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = network_plot_nodes %>% filter(node_type == "Target"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.65,
    color = "grey62",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = network_plot_nodes %>% filter(node_type == "TF"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 24,
    size = 2.4,
    fill = "#2C7FB8",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = top5_plot_nodes,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 24,
    size = 5,
    fill = "#FFD92F",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top5_plot_nodes,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = top5_label),
    seed = network_seed,
    size = 3.1,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.45,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "grey25",
    segment.linewidth = 0.35,
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.9),
    label.size = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  coord_equal(
    xlim = c(-10.8, 10.8),
    ylim = c(-10.8, 10.8),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Simplified consensus 3% shoot regulatory network",
    subtitle = paste0(
      scales::comma(nrow(network_plot_nodes)),
      " genes and ",
      scales::comma(nrow(network_plot_edges)),
      paste0(
        " representative edges; triangles are TFs and yellow triangles ",
        "mark the five highest-outdegree TFs"
      )
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Hub-centered radial layout: highest-outdegree TFs are nearest the center ",
      "and target genes occupy the outer annulus. ",
      "The full network contains 12,191 genes and 101,721 edges."
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey35"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )

figure6b

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6B_consensus_3pct_simplified.png"),
  figure6b,
  width = 13,
  height = 13,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "Figure6B_consensus_3pct_simplified.pdf"),
  figure6b,
  width = 13,
  height = 13,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)
```
